name: Technet 2000
summary: Gold Coast ISP ('You are connected to Technet 2000 - Gold Coast', Jan 1997). By March 2005 technet2000.com.au was a customer mail domain on Chariot's Queensland 'netconnect' portal, i.e. absorbed in Chariot's 2003-04 QLD consolidation (exact acquisition not separately announced in the located press).

events.details: Existing as an ISP by 3 Jan 1997: technet2000.com.au captured by the Wayback Machine — 'You are connected to Technet 2000 - Gold Coast' with FTP site and support contact.

BY-DATE: technet2000.com.au appears as a Chariot netconnect customer mail domain in the webmail dropdown of the Chariot Queensland portal captured 25 Mar 2005, alongside qldnet.com.au, better.net.au, mackay.net.au etc. Technet 2000 is not in Chariot's FY2003-04 acquisitions list (2004 Annual Report), so the takeover fell in FY2004-05 (1 Jul 2004 – 30 Jun 2005); it was one of the smaller QLD deals not separately announced in the press. The exact announcement date is not locatable in public sources.
